newsitem.title: USA: Healthdyne board will meet on Invacare bid.
newsitem.headline: Healthdyne board will meet on Invacare bid.

text.p: Healthdyne Technologies Inc chief financial officer Wayne Bolyston said Wednesday the company would have no comment on Invacare Corp's increased acquisition offer of $15.00 a share until after its board met.
Bolyston declined to comment on when the board would meet, saying "It's our policy not to disclose when board meetings take place until they are over."
Earlier today, Invacare upped its hostile bid for Healthdyne to $15 a share from $13.50 a share.
Invacare shares were off 1/2 in late afternoon trading at 20-3/4, while Healthdyne shares were up 11/16 at 15-7/16.
